title: File:Light-vented Bulbul (Pycnonotus sinensis).jpg
author: Herbertkikoy
description: The Light-vented Bulbul (Pycnonotus sinensis) is an adaptable songbird commonly found in woodlands, parks, farmland, and urban gardens across East Asia. It feeds on fruits, nectar, insects, and small invertebrates, making it an important seed disperser and a natural helper in controlling insect populations. Its cheerful calls and active behavior make it easy to notice even in busy cities. This species thrives where trees and shrubs provide plenty of food and shelter.
